reuse.why: Hooks into the existing pre-link guard that every provider's link function already calls; it uses a raw `db.first` query (matching local style) rather than the existing db.getAccount helper.

duplication.why: The check is written once and reaches all six provider link paths through the shared guard.

placement.why: Lives in the accounts server layer in the shared pre-link validation, although it is folded into a function named assertBankAccountNotLinked, whose name no longer describes everything it checks.

scope.why: A single guard plus a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Simple and central, but the closed-account rule is hidden inside a function named for the uniqueness rule; a separate assertion or a rename would make it easier to find.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link functions go through assertBankAccountNotLinked, which now carries the rule.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked, called by linkGoCardless/SimpleFin/PluggyAi/Fintegra/Akahu/EnableBanking before any change.
